features.note: Facade signage, numbered auditorium entries, corridor carpet markings, and abstract display panels reinforce the multiplex plan without recognizable protected movie imagery.
The auditorium and corridor views show aisle lines, carpet pattern, abstract screen changes, and some wall-panel rhythm, although the wall treatment remains sparse.
Generated menu boards, changing concession display graphics, counter fixtures, facade branding, and room wayfinding are readable, though several snack and POS cues remain very block-like.

IDs and media colors are present, but the amber direction arrowheads are oversized, visually dominant, and not consistently perceived as attached and tangent to their routes. In the UG67 and complete-network views they obscure or compete with route segments and endpoint relationships.
Architecture captures remain comparatively clean while the engineering captures expose labels and routes; suppression is visible, but the complete-network label field is crowded.

important_features.note: People, doors, counters, wall devices, and the compact UG67 body retain a coherent relative scale; labels provide emphasis rather than enlarged device bodies.
Public areas read brighter than the corridor and auditorium, but several white surfaces are flat and the dark engineering views compress internal detail.
Roof duct runs and the UG67 antenna roots read as attached, but dense route crossings and arrow glyphs make multiple network terminations visually ambiguous.

defects: Amber direction arrowheads in the UG67 and complete-network captures are too large relative to the blue and green routes; several read as floating cones or wedges rather than attached, tangent, subordinate route markers.

The complete-network view compresses the in-building network into a crowded cluster while leaving extensive empty frame area; small overlapping labels and dominant arrowheads prevent reliable route-to-endpoint tracing.
Auditorium wall surfaces remain mostly blank, with a sparse acoustic-panel cadence and evacuation markings that are not unambiguously readable as such.
Front-of-house menus and abstract displays change deterministically, but several concession snack-machine, POS, and wayfinding cues still read as generic flat blocks.
corrections: Replace every amber route marker with a smaller arrowhead whose base visibly touches the route centerline, whose axis follows the local route tangent, and whose silhouette remains subordinate to the route and adjacent endpoint labels.

Reframe and declutter the complete-network capture so the in-building topology occupies more of the image and every canonical route can be traced between readable, non-overlapping endpoint labels without arrowhead occlusion.
Increase the auditorium acoustic-panel rhythm and add unmistakable generated evacuation and aisle markings while keeping the abstract screen content free of protected imagery.
Differentiate the concession POS and snack-machine silhouettes and add concise generated wayfinding cues without enlarging the fixtures.

mechanical.note: Mechanical evidence was intentionally unavailable to this blind visual reviewer; false records unverified status rather than an observed console or budget failure.
